title: Zinda Rahe Maqsade Sarwar
body:
Hussain ,hussain ,hussain ,hussain..2
Shabbir ke lashe par aakar ,
kehene lagi zehra ki dukhtar
Ye tujh se wasiyat hai meri ,
maajaye ali ke noore nazar
Jaati hoon Mai bhaiya sene me, maqasad ka tere qura'n le kar
Wo Kam karege teri bahen,
taa hashr rahe hai ek lab par ..
Zinda rahe zinda rahe
Maqsade sarwar zinda..
Zinda rahe zinda rahe
Maqsade sarwar zinda rahe
1)Kanto pe chalo qaidi bhi bano
Har dard saho'n har zulm saho'n
Bhooki bhi raho'n piyasi bhi raho'n
Har gaam pe ek tareeq likhu'n
Bhoole na jise duniya wale
Ta roze qayamat yaad rahe
2)Abbas ki khuwahar hoon bhaiya
Kardungi alam Dee'n ka oncha
Har lab pe rahe tera charcha
Har dil pa tera Hoga qabza
Batil ke Nisha'n mit jayenge
Phir haq ke alam lehrayenge
3) chin jaye Rida band jaye rasan
Gar toote sitam ka charqe kohan
Wo Kaam karegi teri bahen
Hoga labe duniya par ye sukhan
Mazboot pahardo ke jaise
Mohakam thy irade sarwar ke..
4)darbar e sitam me jaungi
Islam hai kya samjaungi
Tere maqsad ko batlaungi
Tere naam ki shamma jalaungi
Ruswa tere qatil ko karke
Teri jeet ke gaardugi jhande...
5)khutbo ki barq giradungi
Aaho'n se aag laga dungi
Tera taqt yazeed hila dungi
Thokar se taaj udha dungi
Takraugi Mai toofano se
Hai jooshe ali Khoo'n me mere..
6)mera nana nabi sultan zama'n
Mera baba ali shahe marda'n
Aur maa hai meri khatoon-e-Jina'n
Hai nehje balagah meri zaba'n
Mai pesh karungi wo khutbe
Urdjayenge hosh sitamgar ke...
7)tere ghar me farsh bhichaungi
Aur shamma aza ki jalaungi
Mai bhai ki yaad manaungi
Jeene ki Rah dikhaungi
Mithjayenge nafrat ke paude
Ulfat ke gulista'n mehkenge...
8) dayeem ne padha jab noha tera
Har samt se zahid shor utha
Kis aaoj pe hai ye fikre Rasa
Kis darja hasee'n hai labo lehja
Duniya me yaqee'n es nohay se
Phale ge ujale matam ke
Zinda rahe zinda rahe Maqsade sarwar zinda rahe
